sources.title: Eyeglass wear among low-income San Francisco preschoolers
sources.sourceType: Primary observational school-year cohort: 133/188 consistently wore glasses over half the school day. Not 71% of all waking hours, HKF treatment completion, or measured utility.

sources.title: Cost-effectiveness of eye care services in Zambia
sources.sourceType: Primary uncontrolled refraction/presbyopia cohort; .850 to .925 EQ-5D among 41/113 follow-ups. Not child-specific causal utility; used only as weak scale context.

sources.title: Dental caries treatment and children/families
sources.sourceType: Primary uncontrolled pre/post GA cohort: 85/167 followed at 3 months; CHU9D displayed as summed 13.58 to 11.09, not preference weights. No score-to-QALY conversion.

sources.title: Ventilation tubes versus watchful waiting: quality of life
sources.sourceType: Primary randomized pediatric OME study; indexed abstract reports no significant between-group QoL improvement. Full page challenged; not treated as full-text verification. Challenges broad hearing utility transfer.

sources.title: Refractive correction for anisometropic amblyopia
sources.sourceType: Primary prospective noncomparative initial intervention in 84 children aged 3–<7; acuity outcomes, not lifetime utility or timing counterfactual. No extra amblyopia stream credited.

funding_room.capacity_status: Scenario assumptions only; no actual available slots verified.

boundaries: Entire gift allocated exactly once. Screening/nav unit cash includes direct pathway delivery and pathway administration; separate general-operations/fundraising share stays in numerator, not charged again.

Three clinical pathways use screen->referral->completed diagnostic/treatment episode->treatable subset; no direct screen-to-QALY mapping. Referral rates are reported historical/undated activity yields, not treatment efficacy.
Financial additionality reduces newly financed screening capacity, separate from clinical completion and patient alternative care.
Completed clinical episode includes diagnostic false positives/no appropriate treatment: treatable_share filters these before utility, not before costs and episodic harms.

No equivalent at intervention start times exp(-alternative catchup*t) models earlier-care health; alternative care thereafter erases gain. Benefit loss/recurrence independently erases gain even without alternative care. Both have explicit priors, not observed HKF survival data.

Cohorts are expected alive at treatment start. Delay discounts to gift date only; no additional pre-start mortality filter. Mortality acts during finite post-start health. Horizon max 5 years; central 2/.5/.5. No mortality prevention, school score, caregiver utility, lifetime amblyopia or developmental effect credited.
Primary-person health ledger orders vision,dental,hearing; nonoverlap excludes possible shared generic utility. All pathway costs and harms remain for excluded cases.

Signed utility is permitted. Episode and independent harms are gift-date PV QALY losses, separate from deterioration already included in utility. Nonpositive health yields null positive cost-effectiveness ratios.

Gross associated-resource envelope includes full gift, partner/insurance/donated screening and clinical inputs for nominal pathway activity, and other-portfolio allowance. Not net incremental societal spending; funding replacement does not erase gross envelope. No full-resource completeness asserted.
Overall/US=all modeled recipients; Bay/SF are nested residence priors. SF central0, Bay.99, not headquarters credit. Regional sensitivity .01SF is a hypothetical mix, not observed activity.
Unquantified portfolio cost stays; zero modeled contribution is not evidence its true effect is zero.
